title: Arabic Empirical Patterns Schema v1.0.0
description: Schema for arabic-corpus-toolkit empirical-patterns.json. Output of a one-time mining run over 100,000 records (1.31M sentences, 71.28M tokens) across 4 corpus categories (quran, classical, news, lexicon). Distinct from the humanizer's register policies — see scripts/corpus_stats.py and references/03-api-design.md.

$schema_version.description: Asset-level SemVer. v1.0.0 = the original mining-run output schema.

input.description: Description of the source corpus (path or human-readable label). May be redacted for privacy.

sample_size.description: Number of records sampled from the source corpus.

skipped.description: Records skipped (typically due to encoding errors or zero-content).

elapsed_s.description: Wall-clock seconds for the mining run.

categories.description: Per-corpus-category stats. The 4 categories are fixed by the original mining run.

n_records.description: Records from this category included in the sample.

stddev_sentence_length.description: Standard deviation of tokens per sentence — proxy for sentence-length variance.

burstiness.description: (stddev - mean) / (stddev + mean). Range [-1, 1]. >0 = bursty (varied lengths); <0 = uniform. AI text typically scores closer to 0; human prose often scores 0.5+. Useful as a humanness signal.

sentence_length_histogram_pct.description: Percentage distribution over length bins. Bins: 1-5, 6-10, 11-15, 16-20, 21-30, 31-50, 51+.

top_connectors.description: Top connector tokens with raw frequency. Each item is [token, count]. Used by the humanizer's Dim 16 (الفصل والوصل) connector-entropy scoring.

top_sentence_starters.description: Optional — top sentence-initial tokens. Same shape as top_connectors.
